parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating member records (`"members": []`), no shared field count, no Jaccard similarity score, and no differing slots — all structural evidence fields are null. Without any grounded evidence about what `GenreTagsView` and `PlaycutMetadataSection` actually share, any refactor recommendation would be speculative. The cluster_id signals a subset-pair relationship between these two view types in `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/`, but the pipeline has not surfaced the data needed to evaluate whether the overlap is meaningful or merely coincidental layout similarity between a tag-display view and a metadata section view.
